definitions: A small fiery particle thrown off from a fire, a burning substance, or a collision of two hard surfaces.
A flash of light produced by an electrical discharge.
A trace of a quality or intense feeling.
A person or thing that is the cause of something, especially something good or exciting.
examples: The spark from the campfire landed on his sleeve.
There was a spark when the wires touched.
He felt a spark of hope.
She was the spark that started the whole project.
